name: PHAPI
postStartCommand: redis-server --daemonize yes --loglevel warning && mysqld_safe & sleep 2 && mysql -u root -e "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS phapi_test; CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'phapi'@'127.0.0.1' IDENTIFIED BY 'phapi_pass'; GRANT ALL ON phapi_test.* TO 'phapi'@'127.0.0.1'; FLUSH PRIVILEGES;" 2>/dev/null || true
